lore: The Harbour Pilot lights a lamp on every island. The Beacon Watch keeps last night's log of every lamp and compares it with tonight's. If any lamp burns worse, a new island arrives already riding low, or a world can no longer hold all its islands at once, the Watch rings the storm bell and the change does not sail until it is fixed.

lines.calm: All lamps burn as bright as last night. Calm seas.
lines.storm: A lamp has dimmed since the last watch. Ring the bell; nothing sails until it is fixed.
